completedDays.summary: Added scripts/gsc-bizzon-status.mjs and npm run gsc:status to list GSC properties, read sitemap status, fetch sitemap URLs, and run URL Inspection API checks for all 27 sitemap URLs. Baseline: sitemap submitted 27 URLs, GSC sitemap report indexed 0; URL Inspection found 8 Submitted and indexed and 19 URL is unknown to Google.

Strengthened /word-counter with practical writing workflow sections for essays, blog drafts, newsletters, social copy, product text, SEO snippets, word count vs character count guidance, and stronger internal links to related guides. Extended tool SEO data and verifier to require distinctive word-counter phrases and support-guide links.

Strengthened /random-picker with unique decision-use content for giveaway winners, classroom random names, team task rotation, raffle lists, and lunch picking. Added clearer internal links to /tools, /text-cleaner, and /private-browser-tools; expanded random-picker SEO data and verification requirements for distinctive phrases and guide links. Live deploy verified on /random-picker with canonical and sitemap presence. GSC shows /random-picker remains URL is unknown to Google while /tools is Submitted and indexed.

Rebuilt /tools as a stronger category hub with Text tools, SEO/publishing tools, Privacy/security tools, Business calculators, and Everyday utilities. Added category-specific related guide links and extended the homepage/tools verifier to require every live tool and every support guide link from /tools. Local build/tests passed. Initial production deploy was blocked by expired Vercel token; token was refreshed, GitHub Actions VERCEL_TOKEN secret updated, workflow_dispatch deploy succeeded, and live /tools verified with the new Privacy/security tools and Business calculators sections.

Added the first guide cluster batch through the support page system: /free-word-counter, /character-limit-guide, /meta-description-length-guide, /free-qr-code-generator, and /how-to-make-a-qr-code-for-a-link. Each page includes intro, workflow steps, four practical sections, HowTo/Breadcrumb structured data via the dynamic support route, and related tool links. Extended support/home/tools verifiers and linked the new guides from /tools category sections. Build and required SEO tests passed. Live deployment verified with 200 responses, canonicals, unique expected phrases, and sitemap presence for all five new URLs. Submitted sitemap to GSC; URL Inspection currently reports all five new URLs as URL is unknown to Google, expected immediately after launch.

Added the business calculator SEO cluster through the support page system: /vat-calculator-germany, /vat-calculator-eu, /percentage-increase-calculator, /discount-calculator, and /tip-calculator-guide. Pages include practical calculator workflows, four sections each, HowTo/Breadcrumb structured data, related tool links, and cautious non-legal tax wording for VAT topics. Extended support/home/tools verifiers and linked the new guides from the /tools Business calculators category. Build and required SEO tests passed. Live deployment verified with 200 responses, canonicals, unique expected phrases, and sitemap presence for all five new URLs. Submitted sitemap to GSC; URL Inspection reports all five new URLs as URL is unknown to Google immediately after launch.

Completed the internal linking pass across all 16 live tool pages. Added a crawlable /tools return link to every tool SEO section and added relevant support guide links for each tool, connecting text, SEO, privacy, QR, and business calculator clusters. Extended the tool SEO verifier to require /tools links, Related guides, 2-4 related tool links, and expected support guide link counts per tool. Build and required SEO tests passed locally. Live deployment verified for all 16 tool URLs with HTTP 200, canonical, sitemap presence, and the unique phrase Browse every Bizzon tool. GSC status script reports sitemap healthy with 38 submitted, 0 errors/warnings, and URL Inspection counts of 25 Submitted and indexed and 12 URL is unknown to Google across 37 inspected URLs.

Polished the homepage into a stronger SEO/UX gateway with crawlable clusters for Popular text tools, SEO and publishing tools, Business calculators, and Private browser utilities. Added homepage links to all 16 live tools and all 20 support guides, surfaced cluster guide links above the full guide grid, and extended the homepage/tools verifier to require the new sections plus homepage live-tool and support-guide links. Build and required SEO tests passed. Live homepage deployment verified with HTTP 200, canonical, sitemap presence, the unique phrase Start with a focused workflow, and no browser console errors. GSC sitemap status remains healthy with 38 submitted, 0 errors, 0 warnings; URL Inspection reports homepage as Submitted and indexed.

Queried last-30-day GSC Search Analytics by page/query. Findings: homepage received 430 impressions (mostly Bizzon brand/login variants) with low CTR; /case-converter, /text-cleaner, and /meta-description-length-guide had impressions with weak average positions. Added a no-login homepage clarification section and updated the homepage title/description for brand/login intent; added practical example sections to /case-converter and /text-cleaner; expanded the meta description length guide with page-type examples. Extended home/tool/support verifiers to lock the new targeted phrases.

Completed final audit, submitted sitemap, documented the 10-day SEO sprint and next-month roadmap. Build and required SEO verifiers passed. Current GSC status: sitemap healthy with 38 submitted, 0 errors/warnings; URL Inspection on 37 sitemap URLs found 27 Submitted and indexed, 8 Discovered - currently not indexed, and 2 URL is unknown to Google. Search Analytics shows homepage brand/login queries drive most impressions, with emerging impressions for meta description length, case converter, text cleaner, VAT Germany, QR, password, and percentage topics.

timezoneIntent: Run daily at 12:00 Europe/Berlin; server cron is UTC, so scheduled at 10:00 UTC during CEST.
